steps.text: classify it: record the defect with --class, --introduced and --caught, or classify one already recorded (classify <defect-id>); a class declared nowhere is declared once first, as the property class <name> of defect (lexicon propose define defect)
steps.leaves: the defect's or the classification's id

steps.text: sweep the codebase for siblings of the same shape (the same comparison, call or pattern wherever else it is written) and fix each one, then record the sweep: what was searched and every sibling it found, or that it found none
steps.leaves: the sweep: what was searched and each sibling found and fixed, or none

steps.text: guard or decide: name an invariant whose enforcement covers the whole class (a chokepoint, or a totality oracle over the class whose test fails on any member), adding the bullet when none exists; or record a decision saying why fixing the instance suffices
steps.leaves: the guard's <component folder>/<invariant> or the decision's id

steps.text: refute the guard: witness a refutation of it, staging a break of the class's shape rather than replaying the instance
record the close: resolved <defect-id> --because "<what fixed it, and the sweep>" with --guard <component folder>/<invariant> or --decision <id>, then run spec --check
steps.leaves: the resolution's id; spec --check names no close with neither
